reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that provides keyboard and button access to prior session messages through an input history panel.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天输入框提供按键和按钮访问当前会话历史消息的输入历史面板。
summaries.en: Adds a browser-side input history panel to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer for navigating and recalling messages from the current session.

capabilities: Adds a browser-side input history dropdown and composer button
Reads message history from the current session conversation snapshot
Restores selected prior messages into the chat composer
